name: Turbo Retail Suite
author: ToniRojas

sections.description:
Turbo Retail Suite bundles the basic tools every WooCommerce retailer needs day to day: a working point of sale, printable barcode labels, bulk product editing and category-wide discounts.

What the free version includes

  • Turbo POS — Single-register point of sale. Search products by name, SKU or barcode scan. Cart and checkout that creates a WooCommerce order. Cash / card payment recording. Printable HTML receipt with change calculation and an editable receipt template. Create products on the fly without leaving the till. Designed for small physical shops that want a simple working till without extra cost.
  • Turbo Barcode — Code 128 barcode label generator for products and variations. Configurable templates (dimensions, spacing, padding), custom logo, field mapping (title, code, subtitle, extra) and additional dynamic fields. Live preview. Print one label per stock unit or one per product.
  • Turbo Bulk Actions — Bulk-edit any number of products in one operation. Update regular price, sale price, stock quantity, stock status and product status. Increment or decrement by percentage or fixed amount. No product cap.
  • Turbo Discount — Apply mass discounts to products filtered by category. Percentage or fixed-amount discount. Preview before applying.

Nothing in the free edition expires or gets locked later. PRO features are shown as clearly labelled inactive controls so you can see what the paid edition adds; they never block the free tools.

Advanced features (PRO version)

If your business grows, Turbo Retail Suite PRO adds:

  • Turbo POS — complete edition — Multi-register with cashier sessions (opening float, close with per-method breakdown), X/Z reports, delivery notes (albaranes) with deposits, returns that issue store-credit vouchers, combined payments (cash + card + Bizum), camera barcode/QR scanning, WooCommerce coupons, manual discount, gift receipt, held orders, receipt template designer and order history with reprint. Receipts print from the browser to the system printer in both editions.
  • Turbo Voice Agent (AI) — AI assistant that operates the store and the POS by voice or text. 65 actions. Works with 14 AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and local models via Ollama; you bring your own API key. Every change is verified against WooCommerce and sensitive actions ask for confirmation.
  • Turbo Product Scraper (AI) — Import products from any URL (title, price, description, images; simple, variable and downloadable products). AI analysis with 14 providers. Supplier invoice parsing from image or PDF (up to 20 files of 10 MB). Soft-fetch mode.
  • Turbo Tax Free (DIVA) — Spanish traveller VAT refund (AEAT DIVA) from the POS: electronic DER issued at the sale with your digital certificate, traveller data validation, VAT breakdown per rate, printable document with barcode, statuses registered / stamped / paid / cancelled, 5 refund payment methods, test and production environments. No intermediaries or commissions.
  • Turbo Retail API — REST API at /wp-json/turbo-retail/v1 with API keys and about 30 operations (POS sales, register, delivery notes, stats, discounts, scraper import).
  • Barcodes — Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A and QR; value from SKU, WooCommerce GTIN, product ID or product URL; check-digit validation.
  • Bulk Actions — About 25 editable fields (prices, taxes, stock, dimensions, weight, shipping class, categories and tags set / add / remove, visibility, featured, virtual / downloadable, purchase note, status), 5 numeric operations, batch processing and per-user undo.
  • Discounts — Filters by tags (in / not in), price range, stock status, product type and creation date; 3 discount types including fixed final price; .99 rounding; scheduled start / end with automatic revert; promo badges; one-click revert.
  • Priority support.

PRO costs 15 EUR/month or 150 EUR/year (12.50 EUR/month, 2 months free), for up to 3 terminals per domain, with no lock-in and a 30-day money-back guarantee. Inside the plugin, Turbo Retail → LITE vs PRO shows the full comparison.

More info: https://www.turboretailsuite.com

Privacy

Turbo Retail Suite (LITE) does not send any data to external servers. No telemetry, no tracking, no license client, no “phone home”. The plugin does not load any script, style, image or iframe from an external CDN; every asset is bundled.

Two MIT-licensed libraries ship inside the plugin, with their licence files:

  • JsBarcode v3.11.5 (assets/js/JsBarcode.all.min.js, licence in assets/js/JsBarcode-LICENSE.txt) — renders the barcodes. Loaded only on the Turbo Barcode settings and print screens, never on your store front end.
  • canvas-confetti (modules/TURBO-RETAIL-POS/public/js/confetti.browser.min.js, licence in modules/TURBO-RETAIL-POS/public/js/canvas-confetti-LICENSE.txt) — the optional confetti animation when a POS sale completes. Loaded only on the POS screen and switchable off in the POS settings.

The only links that leave your site are the clearly labelled links to the product website on the plugin’s own pages.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the turbo-retail-suite folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from the official WordPress repository.
  2. Activate the plugin from the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Go to Turbo Retail in the admin sidebar to get started.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. Turbo Retail Suite is a WooCommerce extension and won’t work without it.

Is the LITE version free?

Yes. The LITE version is 100% free and open source under the GPLv2 license.

Does LITE expire or lock features?

No. Nothing in LITE expires, and nothing that is included today gets locked later. PRO features appear as labelled, inactive controls (disabled inputs with a “PRO” tag or a tooltip) so you can see what the paid edition adds; they never block or limit the free tools.

How many products can I bulk-edit with the LITE version?

There is no cap — bulk editing is unlimited in the free LITE version. LITE edits 5 fields (status, regular price, sale price, stock quantity, stock status). The PRO version adds about 25 editable fields, 5 numeric operations, batch processing and per-user undo.

Why does the LITE discount module only filter by category?

To keep the free experience simple. The PRO version adds filters by tags, price range, stock status, product type and creation date, plus scheduled start / end with automatic revert and one-click revert.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. The barcode generator prints one label per variation in stock. Bulk editing and discounts apply to the parent product and propagate to its variations where applicable.

What does the LITE POS include and what is reserved for PRO?

LITE POS is a working single-register till: product search by name, SKU or barcode scan, cart, held orders, cash / card payment recording, change calculation, quick product creation and a printable HTML receipt with an editable template. Printing works the same way in both editions: from the browser to any printer installed on the system, thermal ticket printers included.

The printed receipt ends with a small “Powered by Turbo Retail Suite” line. It is shown by default and you can switch it off in Turbo POS → General → Receipt footer.

On the POS cart you will also see three inactive buttons — Coupon, Manual discount and Return with voucher — marked “PRO” with a tooltip. They do nothing in LITE and do not affect the sale. PRO adds those plus multi-register cashier sessions, X/Z reports, delivery notes, combined payments, camera barcode/QR scanning, gift receipts, a receipt template designer and order history with reprint.

Is it compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with HPOS and Cart/Checkout Blocks.

Where do I report a bug or request a feature?

On the WordPress.org support forums or in the project’s public repository.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0 — 2026-09-03

  • New: LITE vs PRO page (Turbo Retail → LITE vs PRO) with prices, a module-by-module comparison table and three short FAQs. No remote content.
  • New: the dashboard shows a one-line PRO summary with “Compare LITE and PRO” and “See PRO” buttons, plus a “PRO modules” grid (Voice Agent, Product Scraper, Tax Free, Retail API) with bundled cover images.
  • New: contextual, clearly labelled inactive PRO controls — extra fields in Bulk Actions, extra filters and scheduling in Discount, EAN-13 / UPC-A / QR formats in Barcode settings, and Coupon / Manual discount / Return with voucher buttons on the POS cart. None of them change how the free tools work.
  • New: POS setting Receipt footer — “Show ‘Powered by Turbo Retail Suite’ on receipts” (on by default, can be switched off). The footer is added once at the bottom of printed and reprinted receipts.
  • New: “Upgrade to PRO” link on the Plugins screen, and a one-time redirect to the dashboard after activating the plugin on a single site.
  • Fixed: the POS settings gear was hidden for everyone because it checked a role name instead of a capability; it now uses the manage_woocommerce capability.
  • Fixed: Turbo POS admin styles, scripts and the media uploader no longer load on every wp-admin page — only on the POS settings page and the suite dashboard.
  • Fixed: the POS admin stylesheet is versioned with the plugin version instead of a timestamp, so browsers can cache it.
  • Fixed: the POS settings page printed a hard-coded “1.2.0” as the plugin version.
  • Housekeeping: removed activation hooks that could never fire, an unused option write, and console noise from the barcode preview and POS scripts. Uninstall also removes the new receipt-footer setting.
  • Removed a link to a promotional page that no longer exists. The PRO offer is 15 EUR/month or 150 EUR/year with a 30-day money-back guarantee.
  • Compatibility: tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.1.

1.3.0 — 2026-08-04

  • Fixed: a bulk edit or category discount that reduced a sale price to zero or below could leave products marked as “on sale” for 0, effectively giving them away. Sale prices are now cleared instead of being set to zero.
  • Fixed: a percentage or amount change applied to the sale price of a product that had no sale price now skips that product, instead of calculating the new price from zero.
  • Improved: bulk edits and category discounts are now processed in batches with a progress indicator, so large catalogues no longer time out part-way through. The number of products an operation can affect is still unlimited.
  • Fixed: barcode label printing now applies the “one label per unit in stock” setting to variable products, which previously always printed one label per unit regardless of the setting.
  • Fixed: the Turbo POS menu now uses the same permission as the dashboard card, so shop managers are no longer shown a POS link they are not allowed to open.
  • Fixed: payment details recorded with a POS order are no longer corrupted when they contain special characters.
  • Security: product names, category names and server messages are now escaped before being displayed in the POS, preventing stored HTML from being executed in the cashier’s browser.
  • Security: the product status sent when creating a product from the POS is now restricted to a known list of values.
  • Housekeeping: uninstalling the plugin now removes all of its POS settings from the database.

1.2.1 — 2026-07-21

  • Performance: the Turbo POS front-end scripts and styles no longer load on every page of your storefront. The POS runs from your WordPress admin and does not need those assets on public pages, so your shop’s front-end (home, catalog, cart and checkout) is now lighter and renders faster. The POS itself is unchanged.

1.2.0 — 2026-07-11

  • Turbo POS: the till no longer freezes on checkout — the “Processing…” button always recovers, even if printing or a browser hook misbehaves.
  • Turbo POS: receipts now print through a hidden iframe, so they print reliably even when the browser blocks pop-ups (remote desktops, locked-down tills).
  • Turbo POS: WooCommerce order emails are now sent in the background, so a slow mail server never delays completing a sale — emails are still always sent.
  • Turbo POS: clearer on-screen warning when an order could not be recorded, so a sale is never accidentally rung up twice.

1.1.8 — 2026-06-28

  • Internationalization: the plugin now follows the standard WordPress.org translation workflow (English base strings with a bundled Spanish es_ES translation, following the site language). The POS’s custom in-plugin language switch has been removed.
  • Turbo POS: new “simplified receipt amounts” option — prices and total are shown tax included with a small “VAT included” note; an optional tax breakdown is available when disabled.

1.1.7 — 2026-06-25

  • Print view: set an explicit version when registering the stylesheet (prevents stale styles from browser caching).

1.1.6 — 2026-06-25

  • Bulk editing is now unlimited (removed the previous per-operation product cap).
  • Code quality and WordPress.org compliance: scripts and styles now load through the standard enqueue system; internal prefixes updated.

1.1.5 — 2026-06-20

  • Turbo POS: quick product creation is now available in the free LITE edition.
  • New plugin icon, and the Turbo Retail menu now sits directly above WooCommerce in the admin sidebar.
  • Dashboard refinements, plus code-quality and WordPress.org compliance improvements.

1.1.0 — 2026-05-16

  • New module: Turbo POS (LITE) — single-register point of sale with cart, payment recording and printable receipt.
  • Receipt footer “Powered by Turbo Retail Suite” is hardcoded into the LITE edition.
  • Inactive PRO-feature icons surfaced on the POS screen (quick product creation, coupon, manual discount, order note) with hover tooltips.

1.0.0 — 2026-05-05

  • Initial release.
  • Turbo Barcode module (full barcode label generator).
  • Turbo Bulk Actions module limited to 100 products per operation.
  • Turbo Discount module with category filtering.
